extracted.name: Grilled Cheese
extracted.description: Learn how to make the BEST grilled cheese sandwich! This easy recipe yields a grilled cheese with a crisp, golden exterior and a gooey, melty, cheesy middle. Delicious with tomato soup!
ingredient_lines: 1 to 2 ounces grated sharp cheddar cheese (depending on the size of your bread)
1 to 2 ounces grated Gruyère or raclette cheese (depending on the size of your bread)
instruction_lines: Place the bread slices on a cutting board and spread the top side with a thin layer of mayo. Flip one slice of bread and spread its other side with Dijon mustard. Layer the cheddar and Gruyère or Raclette cheeses on top of the mustard, then place the other slice of bread on top of the cheese, mayo side out.

Heat a nonstick or cast-iron skillet over medium-low heat and melt enough butter in the bottom of the pan to coat it. Place the sandwich in the pan, cover, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, or until the bottom slice of bread is golden brown and crisp. Flip, replace the lid, and cook until the other slice of bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted, 1 to 3 minutes. Reduce the heat to low if the bread is getting too brown before the cheese is fully melted.
